newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki ups offering to 7.4 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki ups offering to 7.4 mln shrs.

text.p: Finnish state controlled steel group Rautaruukki Oy said on Tuesday it had increased the number of shares in its public offering to 7.4 million shares from four million due to high demand.

"The Trade and Industry Ministry has raised the number of shares to be offered by the state to the public after demand exceeded the four million shares offered (earlier)," Rautaruukki said in a statement.
Rautaruukki said on Monday its offering to both retail and institutional investors woud be priced at 42.00 markka per share.
It also said on Monday that the global offering of shares by the Finnish state to international and Finnish institutional investors had ended.

The global offering would reduce the state's holding in Rautaruukki to about 48 percent from a current 68.7 percent, and that this could fall further to about 42 percent if all the additional subscription options were exercised.
